description: Book a service for someone, as the business does for a phone or walk-in booking in the Forms app. The time may fall outside opening hours, but not on top of another booking. The person is saved as a contact and the booking goes on the staff member's linked calendar. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

addOnKeys.description: Add-ons the person wants, by key; each makes the booking longer. None if left out

contact.description: The person the booking is for; saved as a contact

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

seats.description: People in the party; 1 if left out

staffId.description: The staff member's id, from the service's staff list

startsAt.description: When the booking starts, such as a startsAt from replo_booking_slots_list; it may fall outside opening hours

name: replo_bookings_create
title: Create a booking
